messages.content: 請顯示2019年從舊金山被定罪的所有洗錢罪犯，以及2018年從德克薩斯州被定罪的洗錢罪犯。

function.name: law_crimes_search
function.description: Locate individuals based on their crime conviction and location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

We need to use the function law_crimes_search with appropriate arguments. The function expects crime type, location, year. So we need two calls: one for crime="money laundering", location="San Francisco", year=2019; another for crime="money laundering", location="Texas", year=2018.

But we need to produce a function call now. Let's do the first call: crime="money laundering", location="San Francisco", year=2019. Then after we get the result, we will produce the second call.
